reader_summary.overview: Born in the unlikeliest of places — the terrible. The company produced hit after hit after hit: portable transistor radios, CDs, the Walkman, the PlayStation, DVDs, life insurance(!!)... and yet ultimately fell behind its greatest American admirer, Steve Jobs and Apple.

key_points.text: Born in the unlikeliest of places — the terrible.
